entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David. I'd like to start a return for a VeloBand I bought recently.
I can certainly look into that for you. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Oh, there’s nothing wrong with it, it works fine. To be honest, I just changed my mind. It was a bit of an impulse buy for my New Year's resolution.
I see. And are you having any trouble with the features?
No, not at all. I just don't use it as much as I thought I would. I'd prefer to just return it.
Okay, I understand. Let me just pull up your order. Can I get your last name and order number?
Sure, the last name is Sterling, and the order number is VF78592.
Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order for the VeloBand Pulse. It looks like it was delivered 18 days ago, on December 24th.
That sounds about right. So, can you start the return process for me?

Well, for the VeloBand Pulse model specifically, our policy is a bit different from our other apparel. Because the device activates and links to a user's personal health data, we have a strict 10-day return window. Since we're on day 18, I'm afraid I'm unable to process a return for a refund.

I see. 10 days is quite short. I understand I'm outside the policy, but the band is in perfect condition. Is there any way to get a partial store credit, or maybe a discount code for a future purchase? I was hoping we could work something out.

I appreciate you asking, but our system is very firm on that 10-day window for activated electronics due to hygiene and data security protocols. We are prohibited from offering credits for buyer's remorse on these items.

However, I do have a great alternative solution. We run an official VeloFit Resale Marketplace. It's a platform where you can sell your gently used VeloBand directly to another VeloFit community member. It's very popular.
A resale marketplace? Is that managed by VeloFit? How does that work?

Yes, it's an official platform we host to ensure secure and easy transactions. You get to set your own price, and buyers are specifically looking for our products. Honestly, you'd likely get much more back selling it there than through any partial credit we could have offered. It's a great way to recoup the cost of an impulse buy.
Okay, that's actually a very fair solution. I hadn't considered that. It's much better than just having it sit in a drawer. Can you send me information on that?

Absolutely. I've just sent an email to the address on your account with a direct link to the VeloFit Resale Marketplace and a quick guide on how to create a listing. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
No, that's perfect. Thank you for your help, David. I appreciate you finding a way to resolve this.
You are very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
